commons.description: Vestimenta, costumbre y hogar del pueblo indígena Wiwa en la Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Colombia. Es un pueblo descendiente de los Tayrona, pueblo el cual habita en está sierra hace más de 5 siglos
commons.editorial_reason: Caption and source category explicitly identify the Wiwa; the image visibly shows traditional dress, adornment, and a thatched home.

commons.title: Portaretrato familiar al natural Wiwa.jpg
commons.description:
This photo is quite special, because I took it when I was trekking to Ciudad Perdida. Suddenly, in the middle of the jungle, these three brothers belonging to the Wiwa community appeared.
What is very valuable is that the light is completely natural, the rays of light hit the bodies in an amazing way, generating a splendid play of light. The post-edition to the photo was minimal.  It´s such a beautiful way to document the Colombian roots.
commons.editorial_reason: Caption explicitly identifies the people as Wiwa; the image visibly shows traditional clothing and a culturally associated carrying cloth/object.
